land.note: the search bar lands; also a headline block (approved in the 10 s test)

land.big.note: the map card lands, a lower body than the bar

key.note: one take per letter, never the same twice in a row (approved)

key.return.note: Enter: same switch as the letters, its own seed (approved)

blip.note: the searcher's blue dot appears on the map (rank: plausible, best of 5)

pin.note: the three pins drop (earshot rank: best of 9 for 'a small soft pop of a map pin dropping', z +2.3)

scroll.note: the page scrolls down to where your business is (rank: best of 7, reads as a fast whoosh)

tock.note: your business shows up at #9, a different material than the results (approved)

zip.note: the gold outline draws itself around the top 3 (rank: strong, reads as a fast whoosh; pro_zip/up scored +0.2 higher but reads as a record scratch)

tag.note: the 'Top 3' tag: the film's one click voice, its own take (version 3: no pitched pop)

chip.note: version 3, one dry click voice for the chips, the new ranks and the heatmap flips (no triad). Audition v3-click: z +4.0 strong for 'a crisp short plastic click', reads as 'a soft key release click', realness 0.81 (fitted from a CC0 recording); ui_pop/wide C5 read as a snare hit, realness 0.14

riser.note: the build into #1; its peak 2 frames before the hit and cut there (sound.py) (approved)

exit.note: the list slides away before the calls arrive (reads as a fast whoosh; paper, cloth and velvet read as impact hits)

text.note: version 4: one soft air swish per headline line, its peak while the first word rises (high-passed at 400 Hz in sound.py). Audition v4-text: first of 12 for 'a soft quick airy swoosh' (z +2.8, reads 'fast whoosh'), realness 0.98. The finger tap it replaced read as 'a snare drum hit' on 12 of 22 lines in the mix; Joaquín's note, translated: 'I can't tell if it is out of sync or just not a good match'

text.long.note: the same swish, longer, for lines of 4 words or more, so it spans their cascade

tick.note: Google's suggestions, the '...' dot wave and the heatmap rings filling in (rank: plausible, a soft key release click)

flood.note: the WhatsApp blowing up, version 3: the same tone as the first message every time, like a real phone (Joaquín's note on v2, translated: 'a message tone that is monotonous, always the same'). The sparse arrivals use ding.wa itself; this short-ring take (same attack, 0.12 s) serves the arrivals packed closer than 5 frames, where full tails at one pitch fused into a held note

sweep.note: the gold light sweeping across the top 3 (version 2: a soft air swish where the shimmer was)

off.swell: one build per film (earshot's launch rule): the riser into #1 is the one
off.shimmers: version 2: Joaquín did not like the fairy sparkle on the end card ('that kind of fairy sound', translated); its cousins at #1 and on the gold sweep left with it
off.bell: version 3: the glock climb (E5 G5 C6, C5 on the lockup) and every pitched sequence are out. Joaquín's words on v2, translated: 'it sounds a lot like a toy keyboard, very piano, very sweet, very soft'; earshot read 0:26-0:40 of v2 as 'upbeat corporate pop music, glockenspiel', and mallet/glock C5 scores realness 0.07
